title: [REVIEW] Quizzy asset fix — 92% defect reduction
body:
Proof-of-concept fix applied. Defect score 157 → 12 (92% reduction).
Residual: 6 F4 pixelation issues (require regeneration at 1024px source).
Artifacts: fixed/Quizzy/, comparisons/quizzy_01_transparency.png, comparisons/quizzy_02_master_atlas.png
Action: Visual sign-off → close bead → unlock cert gate for publish.

title: [FIX] Dog — asset cert prep (apply Quizzy recipe)
body:
Apply the Quizzy fix recipe to Dog.

Audit: audit detected 4 flaws: F8_padding_missing=1, F7_unity_pivot_inconsistent=1, F5_frame_drift=1, F1_transparency_missing=1

Recipe (verified on Quizzy, 92% reduction):
  1. rembg u2netp on all opaque-BG emotion views
  2. Normalize base view canvases to 1024×1536
  3. Composite 6 anims into master_atlas (3082×3082, 6×6 cells, 2px pad)
  4. Generate Unity sprite_mode=Multiple JSON spec
  5. Run audit.py on fixed/Dog/, attach delta to this bead

Gate: cert/Dog_visual.json must be signed before S3 republish.
Polecat: dispatch to `art-cert` rig.
